## Problem

What user-visible problem does this change address?

## Evidence

Link the upstream issue/discussion and the reproduction evidence. Distinguish reporter evidence from independently verified evidence.

## Root Cause

Describe the source-level finding and affected components. Link relevant code/tests.

## Solution

Summarize the smallest change and why it addresses the root cause.

## Tests

List regression and other tests added or run, with exact commands and outcomes.

## Verification

List lint/typecheck/build/CI checks and their verified status.

## Scope

List changed areas and confirm unrelated files are excluded.

## Problem ID

Pxx

## Breaking Changes

None, or describe them explicitly.
